text: In Gaussian boson sampling, the probability of a photon-number pattern is proportional to the ___ of a submatrix determined by the Gaussian state — a #P-hard quantity to compute classically.
explanation: GBS output probabilities are proportional to hafnians of submatrices (the Gaussian-state cousin of the permanent), which are #P-hard to evaluate — this is what underpins the sampling advantage. Permanents, by contrast, govern ordinary Fock-input boson sampling, not GBS.
